svg.title: How a rule of Flow sends a file to Paperless
svg.desc: Someone uploads, changes, moves, copies or tags a file in Nextcloud. Flow checks the conditions of the rules of the administrators with the operation Send to Paperless, such as the type of the file, a tag of its folder or the group of the user. When a rule matches, Paperless Sync queues the file for its owner with the tags of every matching rule, unless the app is not connected, the file is in the folder of Paperless Sync, has a marker such as [P123] or waits already. With the next run of cron, the background job uploads it as a file sent from Files, with the tags for every import of the inbox and those of the rule, and follows its task. The owner hears of an import that Paperless refused or that failed; one that worked stays in the log. The file stays where it is.
